band: narrowband, f0=900000000.0 Hz
gated constraints:
  nf_db      max 1.7879
  s11_max_db max -7.8438
  s21_db     min 9.8045
  idd_ma     max 6.1177
  mu_min     min 1.0

=== ANCHOR NETLIST (the failed circuit, dialect form) ===
```netlist
* lna-a3-shunt-feedback: resistive shunt-feedback CS LNA with shunt-peaked load.
* Lineage: Bruccoleri/Klumperink/Nauta wideband-LNA lineage + Mohan et al.,
* "Bandwidth extension in CMOS with optimized on-chip inductors", JSSC 2000
* (shunt peaking). Bench-v1 anchor; verbatim of the proven v0.2 external c4
* (round-1 external, wl a6122feb26e8d4dc). Structure-only, ZERO component
* values. Broadband real input match via R1 feedback; self-biased CS front
* (feedback R sets the gate DC); input DC-blocked (C1); shunt-peaked load L1+R2.
* Approved 2026-09-14 (bench round 1, "approve all").
C C1 VIN1 n1
R R1 n1 n2
NMOS NM1 n2 n1 VSS VSS
L L1 VDD n3
R R2 n3 n2
C C2 n2 VOUT1
```
